moderation-queue.order: status null/Pending uses real queue: appeal priority DESC (pending appeal=2, open/reviewing report=1, ordinary=0), risk DESC, waiting UTC ASC, comment id ASC. Explicit Approved/Rejected/Hidden uses nondeleted status filter, CreateTime DESC then Take(limit); current implementation does not apply cursor on that branch. Invalid status/cursor -> bad request; no actor or permission validation inside service itself.

approved-visibility.contract: Directly visible only Approved=1 and !is_deleted, live published article, matching current publication published_at <= actual DateTime.UtcNow, no blocked viewer region. Ancestors of directly-visible descendants retained as redacted placeholders.

pending-visibility.contract: A nonapproved ancestor with approved descendant can appear as placeholder; do not assert whole chain absent solely from status.

rejected-visibility.contract: Retained ancestor placeholders obey same chain rule.

hidden-visibility.api: public queries exclude direct Hidden=3; privileged explicit-status queue and owned attribution query available

SQL UserId==userId AND AuthorMode==public AND !article.IsDeleted; optional article filter; comment id DESC/cursor<. Includes own nonapproved/deleted status facts. permission-filter.contract: RequireAdminPermission(CommentModerate) requires authenticated user, identity_kind=canonical admin-principal constant, admin_id claim and admin_permission=comment.moderate. The interface itself takes no actor and is not an authorization boundary. Public tree AllowAnonymous + public_read limiter and risk filter; anonymous caller is not a normalized role receipt.

deleted-root.contract: Deleted root alone disappears. If an approved visible descendant remains, visible_chain re-adds ancestors and projects IsDeleted=true, deleted content/author placeholders without original text/author. Public DTO contains IsEdited, not exact revision.

deleted-reply.contract: Deleted leaf absent; ancestor with visible descendant retained as placeholder. Reply target not directly visible projects deleted author. Unavailable target/context returns unavailable; preserve actual API behavior, no fixture repair.
